page.layout: One printed page on the scan: a bound book cover (vellum or limp binding) photographed face-on, with a spine strip at the left edge. No printed text block.
page.notes: The scan shows the front board of a bound volume, not a printed page. The only lettering is on the spine at the upper left, in faded red/brown ink, partly legible as a few fragments (a word ending in "...ym" or similar, and "...ina" and a short number line); it is too damaged and cut off to read reliably, so nothing is transcribed. A white paper shelf label with a few handwritten/printed characters appears at the lower left edge; it is a library label and is left out. Blotches and staining on the cover are not text.
